title: Measure dense extraction ownership memory before further redesign
description:
Performance/memory follow-up under TSK-0008. MarchingCubesExtractor now replaces Dictionary<long,int> welding state with dense corner and edge ownership arrays. This removes hashing overhead and makes ownership deterministic, but the tables reserve storage for the full grid rather than only active cells and can become substantial at high voxel resolutions. Measure peak native/managed memory and allocation lifetime at the supported quality range before choosing between retaining the dense design, compact active-edge ownership, tiled ownership, or another representation. Any redesign must preserve exact grid-edge identity and watertight topology.
